# spaCy

> Industrial-strength Natural Language Processing in Python with production-ready tools for NER, POS tagging, and advanced NLP tasks.

spaCy is a leading open-source NLP library built on Python and Cython, designed for efficient text processing and machine learning. It provides comprehensive documentation, interactive courses, and API references for developers building NLP applications at scale.

## Key Topics

- Natural Language Processing
- Named Entity Recognition
- Text Processing
- Machine Learning
- Python Package
- Production-Ready
- Neural Networks
- Information Extraction
- POS Tagging
- spaCy Models
- Cython
- PyTorch
- Free Course
- NLP Tutorial
- Data Analysis

## Getting Started

- [spaCy · Industrial-strength Natural Language Processing in Python](https://spacy.io): spaCy: Industrial-strength NLP library for Python with NER, POS tagging, and more

## Learning & Training

- [Advanced NLP with spaCy · A free online course](https://course.spacy.io): Free interactive course teaching advanced NLP with spaCy using rule-based and ML
